table.name: TLGNC_DRIVER
table.description: The driver of a truck. Is always a user of logon.

column.name: USER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnu_user_id, unique. A driver in logon must be a user of logon as well.

column.name: CURRENT_TRUCK_ID
column.description: Which truck the driver is currently assigned to. This does not say anything whether the driver is right now driving it. Field is updated as part of the Login PDA process (accept current truck), but not reset when logging out. This relation is 0/1 : 0/1, a truck can have at most 1 current driver.

column.name: CERTIFIED_FROM_DAT
column.description: Date since when the driver is certified to drive for Crh. Just for informational purposes for Logon, no logic.

column.name: CERTIFIED_TO_DAT
column.description: Date until when the driver is certified to drive for Crh. Just for informational purposes for Logon, no logic.

column.name: DRIVER_COMMENT
column.description: Comment about the driver. TODO: purpose not fully clear. ABOUT the driver (by an admin), or FROM the driver? Probably about the driver, and should therefore not be visible to the driver itself? -> Maybe CR for Logon 2.0, more data authorization in user admin?
